questions.prompt: Which clause is used to specify the columns to retrieve in a SELECT statement?
questions.explanation: The SELECT clause lists the columns to return.

questions.prompt: Which JOIN returns rows that have matching values in both tables?
questions.explanation: INNER JOIN returns only rows with matches in both tables.

questions.prompt: Which normal form eliminates transitive dependencies?
questions.explanation: 3NF requires no transitive dependencies among non-key attributes.

questions.prompt: What does the EXISTS subquery return?
questions.explanation: EXISTS evaluates to true or false depending on whether the subquery returns any rows.

questions.prompt: Which index type is most efficient for range queries on a numeric column?
questions.explanation: B-Tree indexes support efficient range scans on numeric data.

questions.prompt: What happens when a foreign key reference is deleted without ON DELETE CASCADE?
questions.explanation: The default action is NO ACTION, preventing deletion of the parent row if children exist.
